title: expiry week was eating my profits and I did not want to admit it
author: Electronic_Tea_2948
selftext:
I trade index options. For a long time I felt I had to be in something by Thursday or I was wasting the week.

Most of those late trades had no real plan. I was just bored and the market was loud. I stopped adding new option trades after Wednesday unless I was closing one.

The week feels slower now. The month looks better.

comments.author: ApplicationCrazy1420
comments.body: This is such a good example of improving results by removing trades instead of adding another indicator. Expiry week can make mediocre setups feel urgent when really the clock is just getting louder. I’ve started treating my Moon activity similarly where a no bet day is completely fine if the setup is not actually there.

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: feeling like the week is wasted unless you're in something by Thursday is such a common itch. no new trades after Wednesday is simple, and simple rules are the ones that actually get followed.
